lessons.finding: Headless dummy MultiMesh getters return identity and empty buffers even for a one-box control.
lessons.policy: Keep strict actual-renderer transform validation. A standard headless run may consume only hash-pinned native evidence with unchanged relevant inputs, while all CPU physics/identity/owner checks still run.

lessons.finding: Godot canonicalizes decimal points in node names; all139 source fixture IDs map bijectively,16 names change.
lessons.policy: Validate exact native canonical names and preserve full source identities; do not treat normalized names as missing geometry.

lessons.finding: Source-floor centroid probes on triangulation seams can select an adjacent legitimate source batch after float/physics conversion.
lessons.policy: Retain all6514 source-part probes, place each within its same exact polygon with bounded sub3mm shifts away from seams, keep original failures and unchanged tolerances.

lessons.finding: Godot JSON stores numeric counts as floats; whole Dictionary equality to integer literals can fail although scalar values agree.
lessons.policy: Require the exact count keyset, numeric type and exact per-field values; no rounding or tolerance.

lessons.finding: Mesh.get_faces()/create_trimesh_shape use TriangleMesh data with engine snapping.
lessons.policy: Use surface_get_arrays vertices/indices for raw render equivalence; verify actual collider/support behaviour separately. Theater import equivalence already uses raw arrays.
